label: prop:bn-mtc-action
title: Braid group action on $\mathbf{V}^{\otimes n}$ does not factor through $S_n$
html:
Let \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{any}}(N) define the exact observable modular tensor category detailed in 20.6.13, functioning specifically at level N \geq 3. Let \mathbf{V} specify any definitively non-trivial simple object. Evaluating across every n \geq 2, the embedded categorical braiding directly generates a functional representation

  \rho_n \colon B_n  \longrightarrow
   \mathrm{Aut}_{\mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{any}}(N)}(\mathbf{V}^{\otimes n}),
  \qquad
  \sigma_i  \longmapsto
   \mathrm{id}_{\mathbf{V}^{\otimes (i-1)}}
   \otimes\, c_{\mathbf{V}, \mathbf{V}}
   \otimes\, \mathrm{id}_{\mathbf{V}^{\otimes (n - i - 1)}},

governing the Artin braid group B_n (see 7.4.1) mapped onto the tensor power of \mathbf{V}. This representation does not factor through the symmetric-group quotient B_n \twoheadrightarrow S_n.
heading: Proposition
